about.label: About Résidence Hortensia
about.title: A peaceful place designed for your comfort
about.text1: Located in Bingerville, Résidence Hortensia welcomes you to a warm and elegant setting where comfort, tranquillity and hospitality come together.
about.text2: Our furnished apartments are designed to make every stay enjoyable, whether you are travelling for business, with family or simply looking for a peaceful place to unwind.

aboutSecondair.title: Welcome to Résidence Hortensia
aboutSecondair.text1: Treat yourself to a relaxing and comfortable stay in a welcoming setting where every moment brings peace and well-being.

table.title: The Résidence Hortensia dining experience
table.text: Freshly prepared cuisine to enjoy in a relaxed and welcoming setting.

flavors.title: Flavours from here and beyond
flavors.text: Ivorian dishes, grilled specialities and recipes from around the world.

anywhere.title: A meal wherever you prefer
anywhere.text: Enjoy your meal in the dining area, on the terrace or directly in your apartment.

intro.title: Enjoy great food without leaving the residence
intro.text: At Résidence Hortensia, dining is part of the experience. Our cooks use fresh, local ingredients to prepare simple, generous meals to order, whether you are travelling for business, with family or with friends.

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.text: Fresh bread, pastries, seasonal fruit, eggs of your choice, coffee and freshly pressed juices to start your day well.

lunchDinner.title: Lunch and dinner
lunchDinner.text: A concise menu that changes regularly, featuring grilled fish and meat, attiéké, alloco, rice dishes and daily specials.

roomService.title: In-apartment dining
roomService.text: Order at reception or via WhatsApp, and we will bring your meal directly to your apartment.

cta.title: Craving something or have a question?
cta.text: Special dietary requirements, group meals or birthdays: let us know in advance and we will take care of the rest.
